key_insight: The paper shows that diffusion RLHF becomes much more feedback-efficient by focusing learning on the most informative denoising timesteps and reusing high-value trajectories.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical path to reduce human or reward-model labeling cost when aligning diffusion-based generative systems for real-world deployment.
method: Reweight denoising timesteps during policy optimization to emphasize reward-informative steps.
Add advantage-based replay to prioritize and reuse trajectories with stronger learning signal.
Link timestep weighting to PPO convergence behavior and estimate the weighting trend empirically.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports up to a 6× improvement in sample efficiency over widely used diffusion RLHF baselines under identical hyperparameter settings.
watch_item: The approach may depend on how well timestep and trajectory importance are estimated, so miscalibration could reduce gains or add tuning complexity.
paper_title: Selective Timestep Weighting and Advantage-Based Replay for Sample-Efficient Diffusion RLHF
